turn_text: This is KBUT. The GOP's overhauled tax plan was unveiled last week. From Rocky Mountain Community Radio Member Station KDNK in Carbondale, Raleigh-Burry spoke with Congressman Scott Tipton on what changes Coloradans can expect.

For a couple, it will go from $12,000 to $24,000 in terms of pre-tax income that you're going to be able to write off. Still have the child tax deduction as well. There are going to be some options in terms of the mortgage deduction.
And any changes to retirements?

You know, that was actually a concern that we had raised as well in terms of incentivizing people to be able to put money away for retirement for the 401Ks. Once we move it through the house, then it will be over into the Senate waiting for action out of the Senate.
